scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:client & pnpm run dev:server
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter client typecheck && pnpm --filter server typecheck
scripts.build: pnpm --filter client build && pnpm --filter server build
scripts.save: git add . && git commit -m "checkpoint" && git push origin main
scripts.test: pnpm --filter server test && pnpm --filter client test
